verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documented replication across nodes or zones for high availability, and no documented consistency model for replicated data. State living in object storage (docs-4) is a host-platform property, not turbopuffer's own replication feature. Server-side cross-region namespace copies (docs-33) are a backup/copy operation, an adjacent feature rather than HA replication. The note that writes appear in search results immediately (docs-13) describes index freshness, not a consistency model for replicas.
